claims.location: comment[technical replicate] all rows; comment[fraction identifier]
claims.evidence: One injection per sample; library fractions numbered from the _F<n>_ token of the .d names (F1-F60 = 60 high-pH fractions, paper/PRIDE protocol).
BM samples were analysed label-free (DIA-NN quantification; library by FragPipe/IonQuant label-free). The PRIDE SILAC tag refers to the UHN LUAD arm only (reconcile refutation in validation.txt).
Brain metastasis tumour tissue ("metastatic brain carcinoma sample", PRIDE protocol); UBERON:0000955.

claims.location: characteristics[disease] and factor value[disease] all rows
claims.value: metastatic malignant neoplasm in the brain
claims.evidence: Paper "For 50 BM samples from LUAD"; MONDO:1040026 "A malignant neoplasm that has spread to the brain from another anatomic site". Single-condition arm (study analysed it by NMF clustering), so the factor is constant.
Cohort inclusion criterion stated for every sample: "50 BM samples from LUAD" (primary tumour histology, not a demographic). NCIT:C3512.
Frozen carcinoma tissue thawed on ice and lysed (PRIDE protocol).

limitations: BM sample metadata beyond the cohort level is not deposited or published: no link between the numeric run token (e.g. 1888) and a patient, and no per-sample age/sex/stage/treatment. Age, sex, ancestry, individual -> not available; cell type not available.
Raw data are deposited only inside 7z archives; comment[data file] gives the .d member names.

techsdrf not installed; Bruker metadata read from analysis.tdf of one DIA run and one library run (both same instrument serial); the other runs are assumed identical (same archives, same methods per paper).
PRIDE-level SILAC / Orbitrap Fusion Lumos annotations do not apply to this arm (reconcile refuted in validation.txt).
Spike-in of the PRTC retention-time standard is documented only for the individual DIA samples; for the library runs it is not stated -> not available.
Paper says library fragment tolerance 0.1 Da; the deposited pepXML says 20 ppm; 20 ppm annotated.
FragPipe version: paper Code availability says v.22.0, PRIDE says 19.0 and pepXML says MSFragger-3.6 (consistent with FragPipe 19); not an SDRF column.
